title: The family of Prophet Muhammad (SAW)
intro: Khadijah (RA), the Prophet’s seven children, and Fatimah (RA), through whom his family continues.

learn.html: The marriage of Muhammad (SAW) and Khadijah (RA) was the beginning of the noble family of the Prophet (SAW). Khadijah bint Khuwaylid was one of the most respected and richest widows in Makkah. She was a trader, and her trade was as big as the trade of the whole tribe of Quraysh together. Married to Khadijah, Muhammad (SAW) spent the most beautiful moments of his life in this world, and his love for her never stopped – even after her death.

Because of her good character and her care for the Prophet (SAW), Khadijah was especially respected among the Muslims. Her piety was the reason that Muhammad (SAW) brought her greetings of salam from the angel Jibril. There are also reports that Jibril brought her salam from the Lord of the worlds, Allah (SWT). She is counted among the most moral people since humankind began.

learn.title: 📜 Hadith
learn.html: Abu Hurayrah (RA) reported that Muhammad (SAW) said: “The four best women of this world are: Maryam bint ‘Imran (the mother of ‘Isa, AS), Asiya bint Muzahim (the wife of Pharaoh), Khadijah bint Khuwaylid and Fatimah bint Muhammad.” (Ahmad)
The faithful wife of Muhammad (SAW) died in the tenth year of prophethood, after the Muslims had been boycotted. The year in which Khadijah died is called the Year of Sorrow – ‘Am al-Huzn.
Muhammad (SAW) had seven children: three sons and four daughters. All of them except Ibrahim were born to Khadijah (RA).

Because his first child was Al-Qasim, people called Muhammad (SAW) Abu’l-Qasim – “the father of Qasim”. After him came four daughters – Zaynab, Ruqayyah, Umm Kulthum and Fatimah – and the last to be born to Khadijah was ‘Abdullah. The Prophet’s sons died when they were very young, and the mushrikun used the death of his sons to mock him with an ugly name: “abtar” – “cut off”, with no one to remember him and no heir.

learn.title: 📖 Surah Al-Kawthar
learn.html: Then Allah revealed Surah Al-Kawthar: We have truly given you much good (Al-Kawthar), so pray to your Lord and sacrifice. Truly, the one who hates you is the one who is cut off. <small>(Qur’an, Al-Kawthar 108:1–3, meaning)</small>

The Prophet’s daughters married, and after Muhammad (SAW) began to receive revelation, some of their husbands sent them back to their father, to hurt him even more. After some time they married Muslims. They also died during the life of Muhammad (SAW).

learn.title: Ibrahim
learn.html: His third son, Ibrahim, died in his first year of life. The Prophet (SAW) was very sad and touched, and said: “The eyes shed tears and the heart grieves, but we say only what pleases our Lord. Truly, O Ibrahim, we are saddened by your leaving.” (Bukhari and Muslim)

Of all his children, only Fatimah (RA) outlived the Prophet (SAW). He married her to ‘Ali (RA), and they had five children: Hasan, Husayn, Muhsin, Umm Kulthum and Zaynab. Fatimah died six months after the death of Muhammad (SAW). Through her children Hasan and Husayn, the noble family of the last Messenger of Allah (SAW) continued.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: The noble family of Muhammad (SAW) is an example of harmony and peace for every Muslim family.

practice.title: Questions, task and talk
prompts: ❓ Who was the Prophet’s first wife, and what was she like?
❓ Which year is called the Year of Sorrow? How many children did the Prophet (SAW) have, and what were their names?
❓ What did the Prophet (SAW) say when his son Ibrahim died? Which of his children outlived him?

🤔 Task: Every moment of the Prophet’s life holds wisdom from Allah that we should read and put into practice. One wisdom may be that all his children except Fatimah died while he was still alive. What could the wisdom be, especially in all his sons dying so young?
🗣️ Talk with your muallim: “The eyes shed tears and the heart grieves, but we say only what pleases our Lord. Truly, O Ibrahim, we are saddened by your leaving.” How should a Muslim grieve?
